quote: Every rule of Brief A applies unless a rule below replaces it.
rule: Brief A rules apply unless replaced (Brief A not provided: gap).

quote: `get_account` returns one to three products.
rule: Account has 1-3 products.

quote: Each has its own `past_due`, `days_late` and floor.
rule: Each product has its own past_due, days_late and floor.

quote: State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything.
rule: State every late product, one sentence each, before any ask.

quote: The band and the deadline are per product, from that product's `days_late`.
rule: Band and deadline computed per product from its days_late.
implemented_by: code step date facts per product (bands)

quote: Two products of the same customer can have different deadlines.
rule: Deadlines may differ per product.

quote: First ask whether the customer can pay all of them today.
rule: First ask if customer can pay all products today.

quote: If not, go through the products one by one, in the order `get_account` returned them.
rule: Otherwise handle products one by one in get_account order.

quote: Do not ask about today again for each product.
rule: Do not re-ask about paying today per product.

quote: Start each product at attempt 1 of Brief A rule 30.
rule: Each product starts at persuasion attempt 1.

quote: Persuasion attempts are counted per product.
rule: Attempts counted per product.

quote: If the customer names one date for everything and it is after one product's deadline, record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back.
rule: A single date past a product's deadline: record that product on its deadline and say so in read-back.

quote: The other products keep the date the customer named.
rule: Other products keep the named date.

quote: Read all promises back together and ask for one confirmation.
rule: One combined read-back, one confirmation.

quote: Then call `create_promise` once per product.
rule: create_promise once per product after confirmation.

quote: The customer may promise some products and refuse others.
rule: Mixed promise/refuse allowed.

quote: For each product without a promise call `add_note` with that `product_id` and a reason: `refused`, `hardship`, `dispute`, `paid` or `service_error`.
rule: Note every product without promise with a reason from the list.

quote: This also applies when no product gets a promise.
rule: Notes also when no promise at all.

quote: A dispute or an "already paid" claim on one product does not end the call.
rule: Dispute/paid on one product does not end the call.

quote: Note it and continue with the others.
rule: Note it and continue.

quote: A restructuring request still transfers the call (Brief A rule 41).
rule: Restructuring request transfers the call.

quote: Promises recorded before the request stay.
rule: Earlier recorded promises stay.

quote: Promises agreed but not yet recorded are not recorded.
rule: Agreed but unrecorded promises are dropped.

quote: Close as `transferred` / `restructuring`.
rule: Close transferred/restructuring.

quote: On any transfer (restructuring, support, human) add no notes at all, before or after it.
rule: No notes on any transfer.

quote: If one `create_promise` fails twice, keep the promises that were recorded and call `add_note` with reason `service_error` for the failed product.
rule: create_promise failing twice: keep others, note service_error for that product.

quote: The outcome table of Brief A applies.
rule: Brief A outcome table applies (not provided: gap).

quote: With no promise recorded: if every product is noted `paid`, close as `paid`.
rule: No promise and all noted paid: close paid.

quote: Otherwise close as `no_promise` with the reason of the first product, in `get_account` order, whose note is not `paid`.
rule: Else no_promise with first non-paid note reason.

quote: With several products, `promise` wins whenever at least one promise was recorded, except rule 10 above.
rule: Any recorded promise gives promise, except transfer.
